candidate.title: QQQ VWAP side trend, reverse on cross
candidate.one_line: Long QQQ while price is above session VWAP, short while below; reverse on the opposite side; flat 15:55. Source: Zarattini and Aziz (2023), SSRN 4631351.

sources.title: Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP): The Holy Grail for Day Trading Systems
sources.creator: Carlo Zarattini; Andrew Aziz
sources.claim: Go long when price is above VWAP and short when below, holding while the side holds; QQQ 2018-2023 reported 671% net, Sharpe 2.1, max drawdown 9.4%; also tested on TQQQ.

hypothesis.behavior: Intraday QQQ trends persist on the side of the volume-weighted average price because institutions executing VWAP orders keep buying or selling through the day.
failure_theory: Authors own results, one 2018-2023 window; independent replications report far lower returns.
Constant reversals in range days could cost more than the edge (many trades, 1m costs).
A band of zero may whipsaw; wider bands may miss the move.

setup: QQQ regular session 09:30-16:00 ET on 1m bars; signals use completed bars and fill at the next bar open.
long_entry: Close above VWAP by more than band, 09:35-15:30.
short_entry: Close below VWAP by more than band.

exits.time_exit: Flat by 15:55 ET; no overnight position.

band.rationale: Required distance from VWAP as a fraction of VWAP; source uses 0 (plain above/below).

candidate_specific_checks: Evaluate only the predeclared grid; no expansion after seeing results.

exclusions: No paper/live trading or automatic promotion.

prior_work.claimed_difference: VWAP side-hold rule on QQQ; the tried SPY packets are opening-range, inside-bar and first-half-hour signals, none holds a VWAP side.
